claims.claim: Only allowlisted official interface sources enter the tracker.
claims.pass_condition: Every fetched source identity appears in the checked-in allowlist.
claims.counterevidence: A runtime fetch targets a URL absent from sources.json.
claims.observed_evidence: Eight registry entries; the synchronizer iterates only registry sources.

claims.claim: A changed source creates durable review evidence without automatic module mutation.
claims.pass_condition: A simulated digest change appends one chained event, changes tracking state to REVIEW_REQUIRED, and leaves all authority flags false.
claims.counterevidence: No event, unchanged state, or an automatic application flag becomes true.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: generated source event chain and platform impact map

claims.claim: Every registered module receives a bounded world-fit context.
claims.pass_condition: The impact map contains 214 unique registered module IDs and every catalog item has a context digest.
claims.counterevidence: Missing, duplicate, or unhashed module context.
claims.observed_evidence: 214 TRACKED module contexts; platform verification PASS.

claims.claim: People can read source context and tracking state in Modules 1, 2, and 3 without phone overflow.
claims.pass_condition: World-fit state, summaries, checks, and source links render; 390 by 844 scroll width does not exceed viewport.
claims.primary_surface: live in-app browser and selected proof screenshots
claims.counterevidence: Missing content, clipped columns, horizontal overflow, or console error.
claims.observed_evidence: Desktop and phone states rendered; overflow was non-positive; no new console errors.

claims.claim: The selected guidance is desirable and sufficient for real people.
claims.pass_condition: Mike or another appointed human reviews representative affected modules and records the judgment.
